summary:
Goodreads is the book-tracking site at goodreads.com, operated by Amazon. The brown “g” in the tab is separate from the Amazon shopping icon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against goodreads.com. HTML came from https://www.goodreads.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.goodreads.com/favicon.ico returned png (48×48, 1062 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.goodreads.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 1024×1024 png.

Brand colour #eeeedd comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-1024x1024-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-1024x1024-01.png at 1024×1024 (png, 29722 bytes) from https://www.goodreads.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
